description: Amazon Aurora MySQL clusters and instances monitored by PMM

panels.description: Aurora MySQL clusters with their monitored instances. Expand a cluster to see its instances; click a service to open its MySQL Amazon Aurora Details dashboard.

targets.expr:
max by (service_name, region, aws_account_id, aws_cluster_id) (
(
  max by (node_id, service_name) (mysql_up)
  or
  (max by (node_id, service_name) (last_over_time(mysql_up[1h])) unless on (service_name) mysql_up) * 0
)
* on (node_id) group_left(region, aws_account_id, aws_cluster_id)
(
  max by (node_id, region, aws_account_id, aws_cluster_id) (aws_rds_instance_info{aws_engine="aurora-mysql"})
  or
  label_replace(
    group by (node_id, region) (last_over_time(mysql_global_status_auroradb_commits[1h])) unless on (node_id) aws_rds_instance_info,
    "aws_cluster_id", "AWS cluster unknown", "", "")
)
)

max by (service_name, region, aws_account_id, aws_cluster_id) (
max by (node_id, service_name) (mysql_global_variables_innodb_read_only)
* on (node_id) group_left(region, aws_account_id, aws_cluster_id)
(
  max by (node_id, region, aws_account_id, aws_cluster_id) (aws_rds_instance_info{aws_engine="aurora-mysql"})
  or
  label_replace(
    group by (node_id, region) (last_over_time(mysql_global_status_auroradb_commits[1h])) unless on (node_id) aws_rds_instance_info,
    "aws_cluster_id", "AWS cluster unknown", "", "")
)
)

sum by (service_name, region, aws_account_id, aws_cluster_id) (
rate(mysql_global_status_queries[$__rate_interval])
* on (node_id) group_left(region, aws_account_id, aws_cluster_id)
(
  max by (node_id, region, aws_account_id, aws_cluster_id) (aws_rds_instance_info{aws_engine="aurora-mysql"})
  or
  label_replace(
    group by (node_id, region) (last_over_time(mysql_global_status_auroradb_commits[1h])) unless on (node_id) aws_rds_instance_info,
    "aws_cluster_id", "AWS cluster unknown", "", "")
)
)

max by (service_name, region, aws_account_id, aws_cluster_id) (
(
  max by (node_id, service_name) (mysql_up)
  or
  (max by (node_id, service_name) (last_over_time(mysql_up[1h])) unless on (service_name) mysql_up) * 0
)
* on (node_id) group_left(region, aws_account_id, aws_cluster_id)
(
  max by (node_id, region, aws_account_id, aws_cluster_id) (aws_rds_instance_info{aws_engine="aurora-mysql"})
  or
  label_replace(
    group by (node_id, region) (last_over_time(mysql_global_status_auroradb_commits[1h])) unless on (node_id) aws_rds_instance_info,
    "aws_cluster_id", "AWS cluster unknown", "", "")
)
)
* 0
+ on (region, aws_account_id, aws_cluster_id) group_left ()
max by (region, aws_account_id, aws_cluster_id) (aws_rds_volume_bytes_used_average)
